rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: civic and parks - clumps of 3-5 at the edges and round the seating, open lawn in the middle (zone 154 -> about 100); the school stands in the high-street band
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The school grounds' fourteen builder trees go (scattered over the whole lawn: corals, jacarandas, magnolias, ficus, torrey pines, palms); four come back on their own spots: a clump of three at the lawn's west edge among the planting beds, and one by the school's chain-link fence, so the middle of the lawn stays open for play.

trees.why: the lawn's west edge by the bougainvillea and the bird of paradise: the clump's first tree
the same edge 9 m on: the clump's second tree, an old ficus
the clump's third, among the agave and the bird of paradise: a torrey pine for a mixed clump
the school's east side by the chain-link fence, 9 m from the building: shade at the fence
